content: In light of the recent soundness bug in the runtime, I was curious to know if there are any plans, even in the far future, to independently verify these?
The recent bug did not exploit either of these things. It is very well known that the compiler and runtime are not necessarily as trusted as the kernel, which is where the bug was.
I assume they are referring to the bug mentioned at #Program verification > Is anyone working on reducing Lean4's TCB?, not anything from yesterday.
yes I did, sorry I did not realize it was old
